sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks. Pro
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: AMOLED dark theme
Replaces the dark theme background with pure black.
Custom accent color
Changes the accent color. Choose a color in the patches menu.
Hide layout components
Adds settings to hide the Subscription and Report a problem sidebar entries.
Hide upgrade promotions
Hides the top-bar upgrade button, promotional sidebar rows and the auto-delete upgrade banner in Trash and Spam. Keeps the Empty trash and Empty spam buttons.
Material 3 switches
Shows switches in the Material 3 style with check and close icons.
Remove 'Sent from' signature
Removes the 'Sent from Proton Mail' signature and unlocks the mobile signature setting.
Remove free accounts limit
Removes the limit on signed-in free accounts.
Scheduled Trash and Spam deletion
Deletes all messages in Trash and Spam on separate configurable schedules. Deleted messages cannot be recovered.
Swipe to switch accounts
Switches between signed-in accounts by swiping up or down on the account avatar.
Unlock custom time picker
Enables picking a custom date and time when snoozing conversations and scheduling messages.
